summary: Context::new() now returns Result<Self, CliError> - caller handles with ? operator
failure_scenario: If Context::new() fails (e.g., OfflineStore::new() fails due to DB permission issues), main() will propagate the error and exit with non-zero. No explicit error handling for offline store init failure.

summary: Uses ctx.offline to branch to execute_offline() before any HTTP calls
failure_scenario: If ctx.offline is true but ctx.local_store() returns None (e.g., Context created without offline=true), execute_offline() will fail with 'Offline store not available'. The early check on ctx.offline assumes local_store exists.

summary: Uses ctx.offline to branch to execute_offline() before any HTTP calls
failure_scenario: Same as project.rs - if offline=true but local_store is None, execute_offline fails. Also, resolve_project_id() at line 540 uses ctx.get() which would fail in offline mode if called outside execute_offline path.

summary: Checks ctx.offline only for Pipeline commands, other analysis commands run locally
failure_scenario: Non-pipeline commands (Parse, Info, Symbols, etc.) don't check ctx.offline and don't use HTTP, so they work in both modes. But Pipeline commands check offline at line 591 and call local_store() at line 1512 - if local_store is None, fails with 'Offline store not available'.

If Context was created with offline=true but OfflineStore::new() failed (returned error), local_store would be None. This check catches that case, but the error message 'Offline store not available' is generic and doesn't indicate root cause (e.g., DB init failure).

summary: Context::get() returns OfflineMode error when ctx.offline is true
failure_scenario: Any command that calls ctx.get() without checking ctx.offline first will get OfflineMode error. Currently all commands check ctx.offline at start of execute(), but if a new command forgets this check, it will fail confusingly. The error message 'GET not supported in offline mode' doesn't suggest alternative (use local_store).

summary: OfflineStore::new() called from Context::new() with PRAGMA changes for rusqlite 0.31+
failure_scenario: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL etc. now use prepare+query pattern. If SQLite is older or WAL mode unsupported (e.g., network filesystem), OfflineStore::new() fails, causing Context::new() to fail. Caller in main.rs gets generic CliError::DatabaseError.

summary: ProjectStore::new() has same PRAGMA changes - called from API state.rs and CLI context.rs
failure_scenario: Same PRAGMA compatibility issue as OfflineStore. If API server starts with incompatible SQLite/storage, ProjectStore::new() fails at startup. Both API and CLI share this code path.
